scope: Closed integrated Unit/Bool/I64, Arrow, named call/closure, arithmetic, if/let/emit demo; NOT full TC0-A
source_map_locations: Exactly all function and AST-node IDs, no binding IDs; unsigned coordinates without qualified interpretation
closure_rules: Lambda code_id is its node ID; named code_id is function ID
Captures are exactly free lexical bindings, numerically ordered
Capture support is always []; captured closures retain the same descriptor recursively
Named function entry starts with only its parameter, not caller bindings

frames.return: Restore saved env; add binding; enter body at saved tail flag
Restore saved env; enter exactly selected branch at saved tail flag
Restore env; store one value; enter next operand non-tail or Ready without executing operation
Restore caller environment and produce same Value in its own step

dispatch_rules.step: Collect operands left-to-right non-tail; metadata never executes

ready_rules.step: Invoke then Emit then Commit(Unit); produce Unit
Enter body tail=true with checked argument/captures; push Return only if call site is non-tail

tail_positions: Operand expressions and let initializer/if condition are non-tail
root_rules: Empty continuation Value or Unwind enters Join with saved outcome
Join emits ScopeExit and enters Terminate
Terminate emits TaskTermination and disables decisions
Unwind discards one frame and restores its env per step; executes no user code
site_rules: Empty Value/Unwind: machine RootJoinEntry and Value/Unwind rule
review_obligations: Full A constructor coverage and exhaustive-small monitor product
Enforced protected evaluator boundary before qualification
